about: Every shape of printed text the readers of this program must understand, with what each one means.
This exists because the way these readers were checked could not see the way they broke. Every
change to them was measured against the live archive — every printed range in it, read before and
after, diffed line by line — and that measurement is honest and was never enough: it can only show
what somebody has already been handed. In one day the reader of ranges was broken and repaired four
times over shapes this archive does not hold yet: a unit printed in capitals, a unit carrying a
power in front of its range, a word of direction after its number, a table of meanings whose first
threshold is a word. Both rulers reported no movement each time, correctly, because there was none
to report. A form printed in another town next year is not a rare case; it is the whole point.
So the shapes are written down, in every language this archive is written in, and both the tests
and tools/reader-shapes.py read this one file. An entry with "finding" is one this program reads
wrongly today: the test expects it to fail, strictly, so that fixing it fails the suite until the
marker is cleared. A finding that cannot be run is a finding nobody can close.
